commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'Which error tracking service should the web app use: Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip?' \
  --context 'Sentry: $0 up to 5k errors a month, then $26/month. Session replay included, no upkeep.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month).' \
  --option 'Sentry' --option 'GlitchTip' \
  --waiting \
  --recommended 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"

starbridge ask \
  --question 'Which error tracking service should the web app use: Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip?' \
  --context 'Sentry: $0 up to 5k errors a month, then $26/month. Session replay included, no upkeep.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month).' \
  --option 'Sentry' --option 'GlitchTip' \
  --recommended 'Sentry' \
  --waiting 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
